notes: Floors for total precision and recall. The recorded answers in answers/ are hand written (no real model run yet) and follow the AI edit prompt; the floors are the current scores, so losing a must cut span fails CI. Refresh with the real model through ai-eval (spec 0017 step 3) and update the numbers in the same PR. knownMisses lists the must cut spans the hand written answers deliberately miss (case id and start ms); a new miss fails by name. The rules recall floor was lowered from 0.1498 to 0.1367 when the earlier-attempt, restart and toyin3-pattern expectations were corrected (more must cut time the pause rules cannot reach), and from 0.1367 to 0.1264 when toyin4-nothing-to-say was added (the same reason: its must cut sentence is no pause, so the rules alone cannot reach it), and from 0.1264 to 0.1015 when the holdout case short-take-heavy-cuts was added (B2-T41: 6 s of must cut words and no pause the rules can reach), and from 0.1015 to 0.1002 when unclear-word was added (B2-T50: a must cut low confidence word that is no pause, so the rules alone cannot reach it). The precision floors were lowered (all 0.9868 to 0.9609, holdout 0.9717 to 0.9528; the all floor includes the unclear-word case added by B2-T50) in B2-T53 (spec 0020): each word cut edge now moves up to 80 ms into the gap next to a kept word, and that gap silence is cut time outside the must cut spans, so precision drops by design while recall is unchanged. The rules recall floor went from 0.1002 to 0.0729 when the six script cases were added (B2-T61: their must cut false_start spans are repeated lines with no pause, so the rules alone cannot reach them). The all and holdout floors were raised to the current scores rounded down (all precision 0.9609 to 0.9705 and recall 0.9868 to 0.9905, holdout precision 0.9528 to 0.9541 and recall 0.9717 to 0.9724) in B2-T61 (spec 0021), when the script cases were added, so losing that gain fails CI.
